primary_meaning: Spiritual darkness, evil, sin, ignorance, or the absence of God's light and presence (in contrast to day/light)

alternatives.meaning: A time of divine guidance, protection, or God's presence (e.g., pillar of fire)
A season of trial, suffering, weeping, or waiting for deliverance
The present evil age or time before the full dawning of God's kingdom / second coming
Rest, sleep, or natural cessation of work (sometimes extended to death)

notes: In Christian biblical interpretation, night is most consistently and prominently used as a foil to light/day (God, Christ, truth, righteousness). Positive or neutral uses exist but are secondary to the darkness/evil motif in didactic and apocalyptic teaching. No single exhaustive meaning covers every occurrence; context determines valence.
